# Aura Artisan Cafe & Bistro

> High-end specialty coffee shop & artisanal kitchen serving breakfast, first courses, main courses, organic salads, specialty coffee, and wellness teas in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

## Overview
- Business: Aura Artisan Cafe & Bistro
- Atmosphere: Warm luxury, minimal, glassmorphic design, cozy ambient lighting
- Cuisine: Modern European & Mongolian Fusion, Specialty Coffee (100% Arabica), Artisan Bakery
- Service Style: Dine-in digital menu browsing, interactive in-cafe TV signage, and AI assistant
- Customer Ordering: Pure visual menu with complete ingredient breakdowns and allergen disclosures; no forced registration or cookie barriers.

## Menu Categories
- Breakfast (Өглөөний цай): Brioche Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs, Classic English Breakfast, French Butter Croissants, Organic Greek Yogurt Granola Bowls.
- First Courses / Soups (1 дүгээр хоол): Creamy Wild Mushroom Velouté with Truffle Oil, Roasted Butternut Squash Soup, Traditional Dried Beef Broth (Борцтой шөл), Tuscan Sun-Dried Tomato Soup.
- Second Courses / Main (2 дугаар хоол): Prime Black Angus Ribeye Steak (250g), Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon, Truffle Chicken Tagliatelle, Artisan Smash Burgers.
- Salads (Салад): Grilled Chicken Caesar, Italian Burrata Caprese, Superfood Quinoa & Avocado Bowls.
- Coffee (Кофе): Salted Caramel Silk Macchiato, Artisan Flat White, Spanish Condensed Milk Iced Latte, Cold Brew Reserve.
- Cold Drinks (Хүйтэн ундаа): Passion Fruit & Mint Coolers, Kyoto Ceremonial Uji Matcha Latte, Wild Acai Smoothies.
- Tea (Цай): Hot Wild Sea Buckthorn & Ginger Tea, Imperial Jasmine Green Tea, Lingonberry Herbal Infusion.

## Operations
- Opening Hours: Daily 08:00 - 22:00
- Location: Ulaanbaatar, Sukhbaatar District, 1st Khoroo, Central Tower 1st Floor
- Wi-Fi: High-speed guest network available for remote work and cafe guests
- In-Cafe Signage: Dynamic 16:9 TV Carousel with real-time Supabase sync, controllable via protected Admin dashboard.
- RAG AI: Bottom-right interactive assistant providing menu pairings, allergen info, and cafe recommendations.
